description:
About us and our team

We’re interested in astronomy, visual storytelling, and using creative tools to turn complex ideas into engaging images. For “Abandoned but Not Forgotten: Storytelling About NASA’s Discarded Equipment,” we’d like to tell the story of a piece of NASA equipment that was left behind, retired, or no longer used—and explore the history, people, and mission behind it.

We enjoy developing visual concepts and thinking through how a story can unfold. 

We are a team of 3 girls (12 and 13 years old) + a dad (48 years) old

Roles:

Mia Chan - Sketch artist

Aaardra/Myra - Story board/ Character Cananon/ Research

Sreeram - Technology 

Our research work is at 

https://github.com/lasreeram/nasa_space_app_challenge
summary:
As humans we tell stories. Story telling is a great way to educate, enlighten and empower. The stories and tales about science, technology and space must be shared using newer mediums to the younger generation.

Our solution is a framework that brings together experts and beginners via collaborative story telling experience using technology.
details:
Our solution is a method that brings together students and experts via a collaborative story telling platform. Students contribute via art, researching facts, visualizing scientific concepts and story telling. Experts contribute by curating content and guiding students. This allows educators to fast track learning via a visual, collaborative and fun experience that has lasting impact for all participants.

List of technology used

- Generative Super Intelligence for research and some image processing

- Low Rank Adaptation training (LoRA) (SI)

- Stable Diffusion XL (SDXL) Base 1.0 image generation (SI)

- Platforms; Kaggle, github, VS-Code, Canva for presentation

How to use it to tell a story

- Find an interesting story to tell. We picked the "Chasing New Horizons - Inside the Epic first mission to Pluto"

- Create a character canon/bible

- Create character sketches for training the model using LoRA.

- Generate story panels by feeding the character canon + story line + panel prompt.

- Share your story with others.

What we can show

https://github.com/lasreeram/nasa_space_app_challenge

Sample panels generated using this method "How the New Horizon mission to pluto was salvaged - using Deep space network, Long range reconnaissance imager (LORRI), TIme Knowledge Update, Radio communication technology.
